genres: Coming of Age Fiction for Young Adults
results.description:
A secret operation. Friends divided by war.
And the future's only hope is the girl it left behind.

After stepping inside a mysterious vault, Nora Ray emerges five years in the future. Everything she left behind is changed, and the friends she once trusted now stand on opposite sides of a covert war.

Entrusted with a one-of-a-kind orb capable of turning her thoughts into extraordinary power, Nora may be the only one who can bring peace.

But saving the future means choosing who to trust... and not everyone will survive the choice she makes.

Perfect for readers who love speculative fiction where mystery, friendship, and hope collide. Start the series today.
